# Let me systematically check X positions for different patterns
# First, let me define a helper to get X position

    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'R':  # X is red

            rmin, rmax = min(p[0] for p in b), max(p[0] for p in b)
